{{Top}}
A '''cyberneticist''', also known as a '''cybernetic specialist''', was a type of [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] specializing in giving creatures who had lost body parts new [[Cyborg/Legends|cybernetic replacements]]. These replacement parts often improved a being's speed, reflexes or strength. In the infamous case of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Gender/Legends|his]] entire body was replaced except for his [[Brain/Legends|brain]] and other vital organs.
